q: In which year was the motorway link across Storebælt inaugurated?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020 exam.

da.q: I hvilket år blev motorvejsforbindelsen over Storebælt indviet?

learn.text: In 1997 the Great Belt Link, Storebæltsforbindelsen, between Funen and Zealand was inaugurated for rail traffic, and the year after, in 1998, for car traffic.

q: In which year was the Øresund Bridge, Øresundsbroen, opened?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2020 exam.

da.q: I hvilket år blev Øresundsbroen åbnet?

learn.text: In the year 2000, with the Øresund Link, the Øresundsbroen, the Øresund Bridge, a fixed connection was created over the water of Øresund between Zealand and the neighbouring country Sweden.

q: How large a part of Denmark is today cultivated agricultural land?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvor stor en del af Danmark er i dag opdyrket landbrugsland?

learn.text: Denmark used to be covered by forest, but today about 60 percent of the country is cultivated, in Danish opdyrket, which is almost two thirds of the country.

q: How high is Denmark's highest natural point?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021, May 2023 and May 2025 exams.

da.q: Hvor højt er Danmarks højeste naturlige punkt?

learn.text: The highest natural point is called Møllehøj and lies in eastern Jutland, about 170 metres above sea level.

q: Where is Denmark's highest natural point located?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2022 exam.

da.q: Hvor ligger Danmarks højeste naturlige punkt?

learn.text: On average, Denmark's area lies 34 metres above sea level. The highest natural point is called Møllehøj and lies in eastern Jutland, about 170 metres above sea level.

q: Over which water did a bridge open in 1935?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2025 exam.

da.q: Over hvilket farvand åbnede en bro i 1935?

learn.text: In 1935, the first bridge over the Little Belt, Lillebælt, between Jutland and Funen was inaugurated, and in 1970 another Little Belt Bridge opened.

q: Which of the following cities has the most inhabitants?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2026 exam.

da.q: Hvilken af følgende byer har flest indbyggere?

learn.text: Aarhus, with about 300,000 inhabitants, is the largest city in Jutland.
